recent.text: Final: Rockets 110, Nuggets 100 Durant 23 pts, 12, rebs, 8 assts Sengun 20 pts, 12 rebs, 8 assts Smith 14 pts, 7 rebs Houston improves 8-3 after huge performances from Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun. Their best game as a tandem this season. Rockets blew a 19-point lead then

recent.text: Hustle foul by Reed Sheppard, who chased down Braun fullcourt after he picked off a KD pass, pays off as he goes 0/2 and wins everyone in the arena free Whataburger.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: The Rockets' non-KD lineup did a good job maintaining the lead thru the first 5 minutes of the 4th quarter. Bogdan Bogdanovic and Reed Sheppard combined for 11 points. Sengun was aggressive in the paint. These stretches were often the beginning of Houston's 4th quarter
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Smart move 💡 https://t.co/3X5BcJk7HA
recent.author: Houston Rockets

recent.text: END OF THE THIRD: #Rockets lose their lead briefly but pick up their defense, close the quarter up 77-68 over the Nuggets. Durant's got 21, 8 and 8. Jokic 19, 14r, 7a
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Excellent activity by Jabari Smith Jr. and the #Rockets. Jabari got back to back OREBs + kickout 3 pointers, both missed, but Durant got an offensive rebound and drew a foul to put Houston in the bonus.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: After Nuggest tied the game, the #Rockets have forced turnovers on 3 straight Denver possessions - Smart with a steal after great ball pressure by FVV pushed Braun back - Blocked 3p by Jabari leads to a runout dunk for him - Eason knocks away a Jokic pass, leads to Durant FTs
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: End of 1st half: Rockets 54, Nuggets 40 Durant 13 pts, 6 rebs, 5 assts Eason 10 pts, 3 rebs Sengun 9 pts, 5 rebs After back-to-back losses, the Rockets respond with one of their better defensive halves of the season. They held Denver 34.1 percent shooting from the field, Jokic
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: HALF: #Rockets lead the Nuggets 54-40. Jokic and Murray combined for 27 points but Denver shooting just 34.1% from the field and 22.2 on 3s. Durant is 5/8 for 13p, 6 reb, 5a for Houston. Tari Eason 10p. Alpy 9p, 4/7, 5 reb, 3a.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: The KD-Şengün PNR is killing the Nuggets right now. Constantly putting two on the ball and Durant is making accurate, on-time passes to Alpy.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Another major difference from Phoenix: Tari Eason has been fantastic in his first 9-minute stint off the bench. Thought Phoenix might have been his worst game of the season. He's playing with much more decisiveness tonight.
recent.author: Will Guillory
recent.quoted_text: Rockets look like a completely different team compared to how they started in Phoenix. They're playing downhill on offense. Swarming on defense. Already up 15 on the Nuggets.

recent.text: Nasty bounce pass from Bogdanovic, hitting Eason through two defenders for a dunk.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Eason knocks down another triple and points skyward as the first quarter ends. #Rockets up 32-24 and playing well. Shooting 56.5% from the field, 54.5% on threes and holding DEN to 37.5% and 20%. Durant with a team-high 11 points and seven FGA. Also has 3 assists.
recent.author: Varun Shankar
recent.quoted_text: Tari Eason bobbled the fastbreak pass in the corner but recovered and knocked down his first 3 pointer of the game on his third attempt — had a little fist pump as he came back down the floor.

recent.text: Feels like Durant is bringing the ball up a lot more than before for the #Rockets
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Kevin Durant has been heavily involved early in this one. He's already got 9 points on 4-4 shooting. Also added 2 rebounds and 2 assists (and 3 turnovers). Rockets are running quite a few actions to get him and Alperen Sengun working together. They've been generating good looks
recent.author: Will Guillory
recent.quoted_text: It took KD approximately 1 minute to attempt more shots in the 1st half than he did last game.

recent.text: Şengün got out of his screen a bit faster on that last possession and it more definitively put two on the ball.
recent.author: Varun Shankar
recent.quoted_text: The pocket pass to Şengün on the KD-Şengün pick and roll seems open with Jokic playing high up the floor but the Nuggets big man doing a good job getting his hands in passing lanes. Also, Amen Thompson just generated an extra poss. by drawing a loose ball foul.
